description:
Bug: fz2 run and a built binary overflow the native stack on a body with about 1,000 non-tail calls whose results stay live (tuple {f(1), ..., f(1000)} or 1,000 sequential calls). interp runs both once fz-28p is in.
Cause: each resume step keeps a flat copy of every live value in its own stack slot (TAG_LAZY_CONT descriptor) and calls the next step with call;return, so frames nest and step K holds K values: code, slot bytes and stack grow as N^2 (seq1000 on run: 342 MB CLIF, 18.1 MB of slots; unchecked depth about 24 MiB against an 8 MiB thread stack).

DECIDED 2026-11-13 by the user after three spike rounds (page https://claude.ai/artifact/9XGvVi9fsaHx78cxkzRmBW): build ONE FRAME PER BODY. A body's values that live across calls are one record with a slot per value. A continuation built at exactly one site by another continuation joins its builder's frame: it receives the frame reference plus the call's result, reads earlier values by index (one load, no hops) and writes its own new value into its slot. A join (built at two or more sites) starts a new frame, copied once; a back edge is a new activation with a fresh frame. Member steps hold no stack slot of their own and tail-call. Dead heap-valued slots are cleared; scalar slots are not (a scalar capture in a heap closure is handed out as a reference to its slot, any_value.rs:770-783, and holds no heap memory). A published heap closure is not written except as any_value.rs:754-759 allows.
This is the interpreter's existing model (ir_interp/mod.rs:49 Frame; backend.rs:2527-2543).

Spike (on fz-28p cb4d6011d, run only): scratchpad/s75e/body_frame_spike.patch, new pass src/compiler2/native_body_frame.rs. Measured: seq1000 run 501500, t1000 1000 (base: stack overflow); seq1000 CLIF 2.1 MB, slot bytes 9,200; seq3 CLIF 34,936 -> 24,049; fixture_matrix 3,327 passed, 1 failed: fixture 00910 park pin copied bytes 288 -> 352 (a RISE, cause not traced); distiller pin unchanged 47,910 / 49,346 / 28; 00901/00911 unchanged.

Before building: (1) trace the 00910 rise to a mechanism; hypothesis: a frame slot outlives a value the per-step copy dropped; prediction: reusing or clearing slots by the liveness the per-step capture lists already encode returns it to 288. (2) Exercise build directly (spike ran run only).
Removed: per-step descriptor construction and re-store for steps inside a frame, the per-step stack slot, the call;return frame per step, and every FZ_SPIKE_* switch. Kept: fz_materialize_cont, the yield path, lazy/heap descriptors for joins and roots, fz-28p capture owners.
Supersedes the linked-captures and stack-depth-check spikes (neither ships).

Fails before, passes after: fixture 01252 (1,000-element tuple, today interp-only) runs on run and build; a 1,000-sequential-call fixture on all three paths; telemetry/size tests pin CLIF and slot bytes linear in N (e.g. ratio between N=308 and N=1000 under 4).
Acceptance: full gate green; no pin rises unexplained; 00910 back to 288 or the rise explained and approved.
title: A body's values that live across calls are one frame on every native path
